attributes.board_name: Louisiana Licensed Professional Counselors Board of Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE approved by ACA (incl. divisions, regions, state branches), Louisiana Counseling Association or NBCC; other CE reviewed at renewal (Board does not pre-approve) if in one of 14 content areas and by a qualified presenter; coursework (1 semester hour = 15 CEH). Caps 10 h each: home study, presentations, publishing, personal counseling, research, peer supervision.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Accrual begins only after the license issue date.
rules.audit_note: 10% of licensees audited at renewal; keep personal CE records, do not send as accrued.

topics.who: Social and cultural competence, per renewal beginning 2027 (board page)
Board-approved supervisors (LPC-S); plus biannual supervisor orientation
Licensees previously approved to practice telehealth

rules.legal_basis: La. Admin. Code tit. 46, pt. LX, §707
rules.notes: Renewal every two years in June (deadline June 30; periods July 1-June 30). Also 6 hours in diagnosis (DSM assessment/treatment) - no topic code. Max 20 CEH online (except accredited coursework); synchronous counts as in person.

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE approved by ACA, Louisiana Counseling Association or NBCC (see §611).

topics.who: Social and cultural competence, per renewal beginning 2027 (board page)
Licensees previously approved to practice telehealth

rules.legal_basis: La. Admin. Code tit. 46, pt. LX, §611
